'''Dantooine Express''' was a travel agency that was a member of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company offered "eco-adventure" trips to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] on board a fleet of [[Dantooine Express StarSpeeder 1000|customized]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s. At the time, Dantooine Express operated a [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] terminal on [[Spaceport THX1138]]'s north wing.
